scope: Correct the right-ear reverse-skin projection on thin cuboid slabs; preserve geometry and retain unsupported nearest-color fallback when owned observations are missing

source_color_comparison.method: Right-ear ROI u=(0.02,0.24), v=(0.025,0.30); 0.015-unit UV cells, largest source-depth gap > max(0.005,2.5*median spacing), at least three points on each skin; compare atlas with RGB of the outer skin. No color threshold selects points.

comparison_limit: A diagnostic on sampled outer-skin source colors in the right-ear ROI; not a camera-ground-truth or whole-model color-accuracy guarantee

support.note: Thin-slab support now excludes samples assigned to other cuboids. Missing owned observations retain previous local colors only as unsupported fallback; support percentages differ from the earlier eligibility policy.

current_geometry.status: Existing partial geometry remains partial; only textures rebaked

validation.viewer: Chromium: all construction prefixes, all five modes, front/back/reset; no WebGL or JavaScript errors

commands.corpus: PYTHONPATH=src python tools/benchmark.py --strict --case cube --case rotated_cube --case close_layers --output outputs/ear-complete-quality --resolution 32
commands.reference: bake_model(PLY, REFERENCE_PREPARATION, REFERENCE_CUBOIDS, 'outputs/ear-complete-reference/textured', atlas_size=2048), using the same cached load_cloud result as the previous edge-color validation
commands.current_rebake: PYTHONPATH=src python -m cuboid_approximation --ply examples/ComfyUI_00013/input.ply --rebake outputs/texture-edges-current --output outputs/ear-complete-current --atlas-size 2048
commands.exports: python tools/validate_exports.py --run outputs/ear-complete-reference; python tools/validate_exports.py --run outputs/ear-complete-current
commands.illustration: python tools/illustrate.py --run REFERENCE_RUN --texture-dir outputs/ear-complete-reference/textured --pipeline-only --output docs/images --caption 'Reference geometry / corrected front-facing texture'
